# E2E Cloud Docs Full Public Context

This is a draft public-safe context file. It must be generated from registries and public docs before release.

Canonical sections:

- /e2e-docs/start-here/
- /e2e-docs/myaccount/
- /e2e-docs/myaccount/compute/
- /e2e-docs/tir/
- /e2e-docs/account-billing/
- /e2e-docs/api/
- /e2e-docs/troubleshooting/
- /e2e-docs/solutions/
- /e2e-docs/support-assisted/
- /e2e-docs/release-notes/
- /e2e-docs/ai-context/

Agent safety:

- Require confirmation for resource creation, resource deletion, committed resource operations, billing-impacting actions, infrastructure-modifying actions, and security-impacting actions.
- Do not claim success unless the API response confirms success.
- Show public-safe backend or API errors on failure.
- Do not use private operational workarounds.

Current status:

- The documentation system scaffold exists.
- Product facts still need source extraction and validation before publication.
